title: the set spear and the speed seam
audit_label: R781 set spear and speed seam audit
audit_comment: THE SET SPEAR AND THE SPEED SEAM - three feeds in one round. (1) The R189 chart's set-spear asterisk meets its charging FOE at last: the S command plants the stance (round one + a spear - the stance CONSUMES the round), and the closing monster blow answers to the counterstrike FIRST - the receive multiplier doubles that one blow, the flag clears after it (the JUDGMENT: the monster's round-one melee reads as the charge, the R232 surprise pattern again). (2) The DMG p.66 speed cases leave contract-side: the R158 name-keyed ladder gains its engine callers in the round scheduler - case 1 the tie orders the blows (the lower factor first, a +1 shift on the slower side), case 2 the extra-attack window opens after round one (the before-count minus one rides the +5 routine spacing - the JUDGMENT; the closing charge exempts it, speedFactorApplies), case 3 the weapon-vs-spell segment (the factor minus the losing die, negatives positive, clamped 1..10). The cases read each side's FRONT melee actor - no reach layer exists (the JUDGMENT); missile weapons carry no factor (the R158 print) and read unknown. (3) The R779 zero-row JUDGMENT is STRUCK: the 1eonline.info compilation (the repo-trusted source the R189 duty already reads) carries the full lance vs-AC rows - light -3..0, medium -1..+1, heavy +4..0 - and the R145 audit kRows pin them cell for cell (19 x 11 = 209 pins). Honest boundaries: the printed lengths and space-required cells still ride no engine concept, and the spear keeps its R158 default 7 on this seam

banner.title: THE SET SPEAR AND THE SPEED SEAM - the receive answers the charge, the DMG p.66 cases go live
banner.provenance: R779 left the spear set-to-receive contract-side (no monster charge concept) and R780 left the DMG p.66 speed cases caller-less (the ladder pure data); R781 closes both seams and strikes the R779 zero-row JUDGMENT besides. The set spear rides the R189 chart double asterisk: the S command plants the stance (round one + a spear, the round consumed), and a closing monster blow that round answers to the counterstrike FIRST - the receive multiplier doubles that one blow, then the stance is done (the JUDGMENT: the monster's round-one melee reads as the charge, the R232 pattern again). The DMG p.66 three cases gain their engine callers in the round scheduler, reading each side's front melee actor through the R158 name-keyed ladder (the footman mace/flail JUDGMENT; the lances and the spear now on the ladder): the tie shifts the slower side +1, the extra-attack window opens after round one (the before-count minus one on the +5 spacing - the JUDGMENT; the charge round exempts it per speedFactorApplies), and the weapon-vs-spell segment is the factor minus the losing die (clamped 1..10). And the lance vs-AC cells: the 1eonline.info compilation (the repo-trusted source) carries the full rows - light -3..0, medium -1..+1, heavy +4..0 - so items.cpp and the R145 audit pin them cell for cell and the R779 no-adjustment JUDGMENT is STRUCK. Honest boundaries: no reach layer exists (the front actor reads as the side), the printed lengths and space-required cells ride no engine concept, and the spear keeps its R158 default 7 on this seam
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the set-spear asterisk rides the R189 chart already pinned, the speed cases ride DMG p.66 already honored in rules/weaponspeed.h, and the lance vs-AC rows ride the 1eonline.info compilation the R189 speed-verify duty already trusts
